scenes.summary: You arrive at the Urban Development Hall and run into Iron Boatswain again. He is now preparing for his new career as a trainee watchguard.

lines.text: Master Chen ... you're pushing me too hard...
Endmin, you're here?! Boatswain is gonna be a trainee watchguard. I'm giving him stamina training!
Master Chen wants me to keep running laps until someone shows up...
And ... thank Talos you finally showed up!
This isn't over, dude! Standard watchguard PT is gonna be tougher. If you think my training is hard, Capitan Mi's gonna —
Oh, right. I saw it along the way.
So the Captain needs you for pillar-fixing again? Welp, we got the same crew but things are different now.

options: Since when did you get this outfit?
Mi Fu said a local Tianshi Pillar is down.

scenes.summary: You talk to Iron Boatswain again. He is hopeful about a beautiful new life.

lines.text: Endmin! And Master Chen! You're done already?
I, uh, I got some great news! Once I become a trainee watchguard next week, I'm gonna apply to this post and perform my duties here!
Exactly. The Marker Stone has always been unstable and troublesome. The Captain really didn't want me on this post...
But I wanna keep Grampa and Ah Gou company, and give them a chance to watch over me.
There's always tomorrow to look forward to!
You really got your stuff sorted out, Boatswain.
I got two heroes in the family. Can't let myself be a disappointment, right?
Before I forget, I only became a watchguard thanks to your help.
Come talk to me if you need anything. I may be a trainee, but I'm a very capable trainee!
Great! I can already see a bright and beautiful life right before our eyes!

options: This post isn't the easiest, you know.
We sure won't go easy on you.
